changes.summary: Required a simple operator prompt while keeping advanced JSON, keyframes, and multimodal references optional.
Declared the exact single synchronized audio-video MP4 output slot and its aggregate byte bound.
Validate requested geometry and frame count plus exact H.264/AAC, 24 fps, 32 kHz stereo audio, and synchronization before atomic publication.
Declared the exact single synchronized audio-video MP4 output slot and its aggregate byte bound.
Declared typed request, image/keyframe, video-reference, and audio-reference upload slots with bounded file counts and sizes.
Added named smoke-only, balanced, and qualification-reference profiles with exact 3, 30, and 50 model-evaluation contracts.
Changed the installed default from the three-evaluation smoke path to the 30-evaluation balanced profile.
Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Replaced the metadata-only binding with an installable Modular Diffusers adapter for text, keyframe, and ordered multimodal-reference workflows.
Pinned the post-integration Diffusers source and current ARM64 PyTorch, Transformers, TorchAO, and PyAV stack in a dedicated offline runtime.
Applied the documented int8 component loading and streamed group-offload recipe with a 960x544 single-Spark default canvas.
Added strict input validation and atomic MP4 export that verifies one 24-fps video stream and one 32-kHz stereo audio stream.
Corrected the 33B model metadata and MiniMax H3 Community License authority while keeping qualification at Candidate pending a physical Spark canary.
Corrected the complete immutable MiniMax H3 snapshot from 614 MB to 498.475 GB and updated dependent disk resources.
Marked the candidate as requiring Modular Diffusers and a model-specific joint video/audio exporter before acceptance.
Initial reviewed catalog release of MiniMax H3 diffusers single Spark.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
